description:
As a user
  I want to open Gajab sign-in page and enter my mobile number
  So that I can proceed in the login flow after accepting terms

elements.name: Validate sign-in flow with Hinglish language, mobile number and terms acceptance

I select "Hinglish" language in sign-in form
